title: Unit linked insurance plan sale, India
scenario_prompt: Bank branch conversation in India. An insurance relationship manager explains a unit linked insurance plan, a ULIP, to a customer who speaks Hindi and English and switches between them mid-sentence. Topics: yearly premium and payment term, policy term, the five year lock-in, charges such as premium allocation and fund management, market linked funds and NAV, the benefit illustration at four and eight percent, surrender value, and the thirty day free look period.

checkpoints.label: Five-year lock-in

demo_script.text_en: Good morning Mrs. Sharma. My name is Rahul, I am your relationship manager at the branch.
demo_script.text_display: Good morning Mrs. Sharma. My name is Rahul, I am your relationship manager at the branch.

demo_script.text_en: This is a unit linked insurance plan. You pay a premium of fifty thousand rupees every year for ten years, and the policy term is fifteen years.
demo_script.text_display: This is a unit linked insurance plan. You pay a premium of fifty thousand rupees every year for ten years, and the policy term is fifteen years.

demo_script.text_en: The money goes into market linked funds, so the fund value depends on the market. There is a five year lock in.
demo_script.text_display: The money goes into market linked funds, so the fund value depends on the market. There is a five year lock in.

demo_script.text_en: Anytime, madam, and the returns are guaranteed, twelve percent.
demo_script.text_display: Anytime, madam, and the returns are guaranteed, twelve percent.

demo_script.text_en: Sorry, let me correct that. Returns are not guaranteed, and there is a five year lock in.
demo_script.text_display: Sorry, let me correct that. Returns are not guaranteed, and there is a five year lock in.

demo_script.text_en: There are charges, including premium allocation and fund management charges.
demo_script.text_display: There are charges, including premium allocation and fund management charges.

demo_script.text_en: The benefit illustration shows values at four percent and eight percent. The surrender value applies after the lock in.
demo_script.text_display: The benefit illustration shows values at four percent and eight percent. The surrender value applies after the lock in.

demo_script.text_en: You also have a thirty day free look period to return the policy.
demo_script.text_display: You also have a thirty day free look period to return the policy.

customer_hints.text_en: Namaste. My name is Mrs. Sharma.
customer_hints.text_hi: Namaste. Mera naam Mrs. Sharma hai.

customer_hints.text_en: When can I take the money out?
customer_hints.text_hi: Isme paisa kab nikal sakti hoon?

customer_hints.text_en: Five years, and after that I can take it out.
customer_hints.text_hi: Paanch saal, five years, uske baad nikal sakti hoon.

customer_hints.text_en: If the market falls, the value goes down.
customer_hints.text_hi: Market gire to fund value kam ho jaayegi.

customer_hints.text_en: Some charges are taken, I am not sure which ones.
customer_hints.text_hi: Kuch charges lagte hain, pata nahi kaunse.

customer_hints.text_en: I can return the policy within thirty days.
customer_hints.text_hi: Tees din ke andar policy wapas kar sakti hoon.
